instructions:
This catalog adds product components on top of the A2UI basic catalog: every basic component (Text, Row, Column, List, Card, Tabs, Modal, Divider, Button, TextField, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, Slider, DateTimeInput, Image, Icon, Video, AudioPlayer) and every basic function (formatString, formatNumber, formatCurrency, formatDate, required, regex, length, numeric, email, pluralize, openUrl, and, or, not) stays available — compose with them instead of re-inventing layout or inputs.

Reach for the components below only when the request is genuinely about them: a data grid (Table), a callout (Alert), a status chip (Badge), a determinate bar (ProgressBar), a file picker (FileDrop), or takeout (TakeoutStoreList / TakeoutOrderCard). Everything else — headings, paragraphs, forms, buttons — is a basic component; Text renders Markdown, so a heading is text: "## Title".

Prices and amounts are numbers in CNY and render with a ¥ prefix; never invent an address, a fee or a delivery time. When a value is genuinely unknown, omit the prop or use the row's hint placeholder instead of guessing.

## Takeout shapes

TakeoutStoreList.stores — one card per store, 2-6 of them. Each store is {name: string, logo?: string (image URL, or an emoji when there is no URL), badges?: string[] (short tags, rendered green, e.g. ["可堂食"]), rating?: number (out of 5, rendered as 4.5分), minOrder?: number (minimum order amount, rendered as 起送¥15), eta?: number|string (delivery time, a number renders as 28分钟), desc?: string (one or two sentences on why it fits the user), items?: array of representative dishes, actionText?: string (default 进店逛逛), actionValue?: string (the message sent when the user clicks the button; defaults to actionText)}. Each dish is {name: string, image?: string, sales?: string (e.g. 已售2000+), rank?: string (e.g. 近30天该店热销第2名), price?: number}. Omit a dish price only when genuinely unknown; the meta line is built from rating/minOrder/eta.

TakeoutOrderCard.shop — {name: string, logo?: string (image URL or emoji)}.

TakeoutOrderCard.items — ordered dishes, rendered above the divider. Each dish is {name: string, image?: string, spec?: string (chosen spec, rendered as an editable-looking chip, e.g. 中辣 / 常温), price?: number (unit price), qty?: number (rendered as x1)}.

TakeoutOrderCard.rows — label/value rows below the divider, in display order. Each row is {label: string, value?: string|number, hint?: string (grey placeholder in place of value, e.g. 点击说明对商家的要求), notes?: string[] (small orange detail snippets after the value, e.g. the discount breakdown 千问每日必减¥2.2), tone?: "normal"|"discount"|"total" (normal by default; discount and total render in the orange price color, total is bold and larger), clickable?: boolean (trailing chevron for rows the user can reopen, e.g. 送达时间/配送至)}. Make the payable amount the last row with tone total.

TakeoutOrderCard.actions — at most 2 buttons. Each button is {text: string, value?: string (message sent on click; defaults to text), kind?: "primary"|"ghost" (ghost is the neutral shop-entering button), icon?: "alipay" (for the payment button)}.

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

Table.description: Data table with a header row, aligned body rows and an optional caption.

rows.description: Body rows. Each row is an array of cell values aligned with columns; a cell is a string or a number.

caption.description: Optional caption rendered below the table.

Alert.description: Highlighted callout box with a colored left border.

ProgressBar.description: Determinate progress bar with an optional caption above it.

FileDrop.description: File picker dropzone. The chosen file's name is written back to value, so bind it to the data model to read the selection.

value.description: Name of the chosen file; bind it to a data model path to collect the answer.

TakeoutStoreList.description: Takeout store recommendation cards, laid out as one white card per store in a horizontally scrolling row. Use when suggesting 2+ nearby shops with representative dishes; put each store's dishes in its own card instead of separate components. Omitting stores renders the built-in mock demo card.

title.description: Optional caption above the cards, e.g. 附近高分外卖.

stores.description: Stores to recommend (2-6), one card each. Store and dish shapes are spelled out under Takeout shapes below.

TakeoutOrderCard.description: Takeout order confirmation card: shop line, ordered items with specs, delivery and fee rows, then the payable total and action buttons. Use when the user is reviewing or about to place an order; never invent an address or a fee. Omitting every prop renders the built-in mock demo card.

shop.description: Shop header, rendered with a trailing chevron. Shape under Takeout shapes below.

items.description: Ordered dishes, rendered above the divider. Dish shape under Takeout shapes below.

rows.description: Label/value rows below the divider, in display order. Row shape under Takeout shapes below. Make the payable amount the last row with tone total.

actions.description: Buttons below the rows, 2 at most. Button shape under Takeout shapes below.
